purpose: Predeclared synthetic moving-container verification; not measured materials or a compiler performance benchmark
reference_gate: All four adjacent primary-update and velocity-iteration refinement edges must satisfy quarter budgets. Unqualified comparisons are diagnostic only.
geometry: Exact disks of radius 0.1 m and mass 1 kg, explicit 0.01 m polygon contact skin, four walls on one kinematic body; independent frame-sampled wall and pair checks
material: mu=0.4 and e=0 for frictional grids, mu=e=0 for analytical rows and invariance controls; synthetic, not empirically calibrated
limitations: Native Box2D comparators, not current Vektor compiler, WASM or physical GPU; no claimed asymptotic order at impact; first-frame row checks include narrowphase/contact discovery and floating geometry as well as solver propagation
work_accounting: W=U dot delta P only for constant pure translation, zero gravity. Accelerating/rotating box work needs a future time-resolved contact impulse ledger.
